verdict.rationale: SavvyCal offers rule-based ways to steer bookings toward better times rather than the first open slot. It presents ranked availability windows to nudge recipients toward the optimal time, encourages booking near other meetings to avoid fragmentation, and honors time-budget preferences. It also combines availability across teammates and external calendars and lets recipients overlay their own calendar to find mutual availability. None of this is described as AI-driven, and nothing shows the time being re-optimized after booking. Missing for 10: AI/ML-driven time selection, continuous re-optimization or automatic rescheduling, any independent or hands-on corroboration.
